propositions: The enrichment queue reduce opens all matching event files on every call, causing O(history) file opens per ticket that grow unbounded as re-runs accumulate, exceeding the 20 ms drain-gate budget by 20-30x on the live tracker.

The queue reduce must implement newest-first, lazy event file reading for each type (using filename timestamp prefix ordering) to bound opens to at most one file per type per ticket in the no-corruption case.
Corrupt newest event files must fall back gracefully to the next-older parseable file rather than failing the reduce.
Event filename timestamp prefixes must equal the event body timestamp field to guarantee lexicographic filename order matches temporal order for the suffix-scan optimization.
Pre-enqueue CLAIM events must be skipped by claim() arbitration via a contiguous-suffix walk (stop when filename timestamp ≤ latest ENQUEUE), bounding reads to the contention window.
This change deletes no event files, renames no files, and writes no files, preserving concurrency invariants and cross-clone union merges.
